Maya Patel: Heads-up — PulseMed MAU fell to ~18% this week after week-1 onboarding. Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.app/pulse/pulse-med/usage  
Liam Chen: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Do we know if their champion Nora left or is this purely friction?  
Priya Rao: Confirmed — Nora handed off to a new VP of Data last week, didn't attend the final onboarding session. Procurement flagged a competitor eval in the same thread.  
Maya Patel: Also saw repeated errors when they tried the model export step. Pasting the small log we captured during repro:  
Maya Patel: ```
ERROR 502 gateway timeout
service inference-gateway -> model-pool timeout 15s
stack: gateway/proxy.go:142 -> pool/alloc.go:78
```  
Tessa Gómez: Ok — two quick containment play options: 1) offer a 30-day rollout extension + priority triage, 2) hands-on demo for the new VP. I lean both. :+1:  
Liam Chen: I'll reach out to the new VP and procurement. @Priya can you kick off the rewarm playbook and schedule a recovery session?  
Priya Rao: On it. Running playbook 'onboard-rewarm-v2' now, will attach checklist and shop fixes for model-export. Scheduled a 30-min kickoff Fri 10am PT — invite sent. KB: https://kb.redwood/integrations/onboard-rewarm  
usage-alert-bot: Alert triggered — MAU down 62% vs baseline (7d). Incident ID: INC-17500. Related metric links: https://metrics.redwood/INC-17500  
Maya Patel: Thanks. Can Eng triage the 502 path? If we can patch export within 24-48h and do a short demo to the new VP, we can probably stall the competitive eval.  
Liam Chen: I'll draft a procurement note to buy time and propose the extension. Sending draft in #sales-comm shortly.  
Tessa Gómez: I can join the demo and escalation call. Priya — please include a compact enablement deck focused on export + ROI examples.  
Priya Rao: Will prepare deck and the one-page playbook snippet for the VP. Attaching checklist after triage.  
Maya Patel: Good triage. Next steps: Eng triage (24h), Priya enablement + kickoff, Liam procurement stall, Tessa demo join. I'll update this thread after kickoff.  
Liam Chen: +1  
Tessa Gómez: +1  
Priya Rao: +1  
Maya Patel: I'll also ask CS research to pull a short retention note for PulseMed to surface in the call.
